title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup | TechCrunch
summary: The report comes a few days after SpaceX’s $60 billion acquisition of Cursor, another AI coding startup, whose deal closed last week. SpaceX acquired Musk’s AI company, xAI, earlier this year.
